name: Bonnet
overview: The biblical references to bonnets highlight their significance both as part of the priestly garments and as adornments for women. For Aaron and his sons, bonnets made of fine linen symbolized glory and beauty and were integral to their consecration and perpetual priestly office, as seen in Exodus and Leviticus. Additionally, bonnets are mentioned among the ornaments worn by women, indicating their role in personal adornment, as noted in Isaiah. Ezekiel further emphasizes the purity and appropriateness of linen bonnets for priests, underscoring their distinctiveness and holiness.
